::: {.callout-note appearance='simple' collapse=true}
## Source

Kameron Decker Harris's Fall 2026 syllabus opens the course with an introduction to functional programming;
this chapter, its examples and its exercises are new,
except the exercise on `lambda`,
which is adapted from Jerry Cain's Stanford CS 107 handouts on Scheme [@cain2008cs107]
under the [Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 United States License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/),
and says so in its own Source note.

The definitions of expression, function, argument and value are included from the
[mathematics prerequisites](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/) notes,
so they read the same in both places.
:::
